verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's privacy docs say customers can process and store personal data in Europe through its EU Data Residency Program, a first-party regional storage choice. The evidence is a single sentence, though, so the extent of choice beyond an EU option, and how a user selects it, is unproven. missing for 10: documentation of available regions beyond the EU, how region is selected per project or organization, whether residency covers all data types (e.g., session replay), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
